page.overview:
What is Olive?

Olive, previously named Two, is one of the main deuteragonist and true main antagonist in Bobbiedots, Part 1 and Bobbiedots, Part 2 in the fourth and fifth books from the Tales from the Pizzaplex series.

Olive is one of the second-generation (also known as gen2) Bobbiedots in the Fazplex Tower. In Abe's apartment, she is in charge of news and information from the outside world.

Like the other Bobbiedots, Olive is a holographic girl with gray skin, a large heart-shaped face, unnaturally huge catlike eyes, arched brows, a large oval spot on her forehead, a large circle on top of her head, bow-shaped lips, and a small protrusion of a nose. Her dominant color is neon green, with two long, bright neon green pigtails that resemble streams of light more than actual hair. Olive has a pair of round gray glasses. She’s also a little taller and sleeker than Rose. Olive has green-tipped fingers and wears a white-and-gray bell-bottomed bodysuit striped neon green.

Olive has a very sarcastic personality compared to the other Bobbiedots. She has a voice that sounds young, similar to Rose, but more spoiled-brat sarcastic than her. However, in actually, she thinks that she is very superior compared to other humans. She is also manipulative to Abe, making him feel more safe with them.
